script_beats.gist: Hook. Most AI video tools generate a video; REAL edits yours and shows its work.
Four steps, four files: the notebook, your script with the shots marked inline.
The catalogue: every clip described, anything unverified marked unknown.
The reel: every picture pinned to a word, not a timestamp; re-recording moves nothing you approved.
Compile: a real timeline for Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve; what it cannot represent, it refuses.
Payoff: this trailer was made with REAL; its notebook is in the repository.
